title: Influence outside the restricted coordinates
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and fix signs on all coordinates outside $J$. For the function obtained by allowing the coordinates in $J$ to vary freely while using those fixed signs elsewhere, every coordinate $i\notin J$ has influence zero.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a subset of the coordinates
$z$ fixes a sign at each coordinate outside $J$
